title: Show HN: BBRouter – Ben Eater's 8-bit computer, simulated on 3D breadboards
summary: Hi HN, I kept wiring Ben Eater's 8-bit computer wrong, so I built a realistic virtual breadboard editor. Some of the nice features are side-by-side diff, scope, schematics auto-sync, auto-router (BBRouter stands for breadboard router), and my favorites: upload from the real Ardui
reason: Show HN for a virtual breadboard simulator of Ben Eater's 8-bit computer; it is not an AI model, research, industry event, policy action, or AI/OSS developer tool, so no active rule covers it.
